info.description: The board that closes /about/history-legacy/. ⚠⚠ THIS IS NOT THE STUDENT COUNCIL AND NOT THE SCHOOL MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE. Three different bodies, and this CMS holds all three separately: the STUDENT council is children (Student Council); the SMC is the statutory CBSE filing (Disclosure Page); this is a panel of academics, officials and the group's own directors that the school chose. Do not merge them. ⚠⚠ ITS OWN RECORD RATHER THAN A FIELD ON HISTORY PAGE, ON PURPOSE: History Page is rewritten whole by `npm run seed:pages`, so anything added there would be restored to the fixture by a seed run meant for something else. ⚠ IT IS A SEPARATE SINGLE TYPE BUT NOT A SEPARATE PAGE — audit 1.11 says dignitaries belong inside the History section rather than behind a new menu link.

board.description: The school's ADVISORY COUNCIL board. This is the whole of what a visitor sees — there is no heading text and no list drawn under it. ⚠ REPLACING IT MEANS RETYPING THE MEMBERS BELOW IN THE SAME SAVE.

advisors.description: The members, in the board's own order — left to right, then down. ⚠⚠ NOT DRAWN ON THE PAGE. They become the board image's alt text, which is the only text these names exist in. ⚠ IT IS NOT ALPHABETICAL AND NOT RANKED: the Chairperson leads, but the Vice Chairperson is sixth and the Director ninth. Re-sorting invents a hierarchy the school did not publish.
